title: Require Native Service oRPC Composition
forbids: a service without distinct exact service and host-admission views, an exported service view not rooted directly on base, a module that reaches upward for its implementer instead of owning an exact native authoring view, an unprojected root branch, or a runtime namespace import from an oRPC composition vendor
why: A base-rooted native service view preserves visible ownership while each root branch receives a module-owned projection and completed router without introducing a second composition framework.
remediate: Create the standalone base with implementEffect(contract, ...).$context<Context>(). Derive service directly from base and native middleware, and derive boundary in impl.ts. Create each module from its own contract with an exact Context, then compose each completed module router through its service branch with a module-owned provideContext. Use named runtime vendor imports.
message: Service composition must preserve direct native authoring views and one host-admission boundary.
